name: GATE EE Power Systems Prep - Practice Test 2

questions.question: Which relay is used for the protection of long transmission lines?
questions.hint: Mho relays are least affected by power swings, ideal for long lines.

questions.question: What is the primary function of a moderator in a nuclear reactor?
questions.hint: Moderators reduce the speed of fast neutrons to make them thermal for fission.

questions.question: In a synchronous motor, the speed is determined by:
questions.hint: Synchronous speed Ns = 120f / P, determined solely by grid frequency.

questions.question: What is the typical efficiency of a large power transformer?
questions.hint: Large transformers have minimal copper and iron losses, achieving 98%+ efficiency.

questions.question: Which method is used for load flow analysis in complex networks?
questions.hint: Gauss-Seidel, Newton-Raphson, and Fast Decoupled are standard load flow methods.

questions.question: A buck converter is used to:
questions.hint: Buck converters act as step-down DC-to-DC converters.

questions.question: Which semiconductor switch can be turned off by gate control?
questions.hint: GTOs can be turned off by applying a negative gate pulse.

questions.question: The corona loss in transmission lines is higher during:
questions.hint: Moisture in air lowers breakdown strength, increasing corona discharge.

questions.question: What is the relation between line and phase voltage in a delta connection?
questions.hint: In delta, terminals share the same lines so line voltage equals phase voltage.

questions.question: What is the relation between line and phase current in a star connection?
questions.hint: In star, line current passes directly into the phase winding.

questions.question: Which plant has the lowest running cost per unit generated?
questions.hint: Hydroelectric energy relies on water gravity flows, costing zero fuel expenses.

questions.question: In power systems, surge impedance loading is proportional to:
What is the function of a lightning arrester?
options: Divert high voltage surges to ground
questions.hint: Lightning arresters offer a low-resistance path to bypass surge currents to earth.

questions.question: The slip of a synchronous motor at normal operating speed is:
questions.hint: Synchronous motors run at synchronous speed, meaning slip (Ns - N)/Ns = 0.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of HVDC transmission?
options: Lower skin effect and lower line losses
questions.hint: HVDC lines do not have skin effect losses or reactive power losses.
